messages:
Ava (Marketing): Heads-up 11 We need final audience splits + send plan for the SparkWave launch newsletter. Draft is at https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/sparkwave-launch. Please review the segment rules and flag anything missing.

Rohit (Growth): Reviewing now. Proposal: 3-way segmentation by trial recency + engagement: 45% active trials (last 14d), 30% dormant trials (15-90d), 15% product users (no trial), 10% partners/integrations. Geo-stagger NA/EMEA/APAC across 48h to protect deliverability.

Samira (Content): I pushed a trimmed hero and 3 subject variants in the doc. Short list: 
- "SparkWave: Faster LLM inference for production"
- "Cut token latency. Ship LLM features faster."
- "Early access: lower-cost, reliable inference"
I suggest testing 2 subjects x 2 preheaders (benefit vs curiosity). Will shorten body to 3 bullets + two CTAs (docs + demo).

Michael (Ops): ESP warning: production throttling threshold is 180k/hr. For a safe margin set initial burst 120k/hr. Seed test of 1k will run tomorrow 09:30 PT. Also confirm suppression lists: global_unsub, trial_opt_out, internal_dedicated_customers. Ill export and share.

Ava (Marketing): Good. Add fallback: if ESP returns >2% bounces in first hour, pause and reroute remainder into a 48h drip reminder. Also need tracking UTMs.

Rohit (Growth): UTMs: utm_campaign=sparkwave_launch&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email. Conversion metric: demo_signup within 7d. Ill set up A/B allocation and weighting to favor engaged opens.

Samira (Content): For the benchmark line, can we use "median latency reduced by X%"? Need legal-approved phrasing. @Ava please confirm exact stat and approved wording.

Ava (Marketing): Yes we have approval for a high-level stat. Ill paste the approved copy into the doc by EOD today. Keep it non-technical.

Michael (Ops): Action plan: today 11 extract segments + run suppression; tomorrow 09:30 PT seed send (1k); 10:00 PT deliverability review; starting cadence Thursday 10:00 PT for NA. Ill add monitors for bounce rate, complaints, and throttle events.

Rohit (Growth): Segment tweak: exclude any account in enterprise rollout cohort and anyone with active sales engagement. Add engaged flag = opened any marketing email in last 90d to increase weight.

Samira (Content): Ill finalize subject lines + two preheaders by EOD and wire up the 2x2 test matrix in the doc.

campaign-bot: Campaign workspace updated: "sparkwave-launch-newsletter". Reminder scheduled for marketing review tomorrow 10:00 AM PT.

Ava (Marketing): Quick checklist:
- Samira: finalize subject + preheaders (EOD)
- Michael: export suppression + run seed test (today/tomorrow)
- Rohit: configure A/B test + UTMs (tomorrow AM)
- Ava: approve benchmark copy + final hero (tomorrow AM)

Samira (Content): On it 44d

Michael (Ops): Ill post seed test report after the run.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks all. Keep it tight and ping me for blockers. :rocket:
